judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

M.M. Sundresh, J.:— The petitioner is the wife of the convict. This habeas corpus petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking a direction to the respondents to grant 15 days leave to the convict on two grounds viz., to give adequate treatment to the mother of the convict and to take care of the education of the children.

2. Though the learned Additional Public Prosecutor submitted that the report of the Probation Officer does not subscribe to the reasons assigned, we are inclined to grant one week leave to the convict for the reason that admittedly the children of the convict are studying in the school. The adequacy of the assistance required from the convict cannot be measured with precision. The fact that the convict has got aged mother is also not in dispute though she may not be as ill as projected by the petitioner. Considering the above, we are inclined to grant seven days leave to the convict.

3. Accordingly, the convict is granted one week leave starting from 24.09.2019 to 30.09.2019 with minimum escort. The detenu shall be released at 10.00 a.m. on 24.09.2019 and he shall return back to the prison on 30.09.2019 at 5.00 p.m.

4. In view of the above, the Habeas Corpus Petition stands disposed of.

5. Post the matter ‘for reporting compliance’ on 01.10.2019.
